description: Evaluate simple Python functions with an early return and unreachable assignment; matched controls ask the initial literal value.

random.seed(0)
a=[];c=[]

 c.append({'prompt':stem+'What integer is initially assigned to x? Answer:','answer':' '+str(x)})
json.dump({'items':a,'control':c},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
